text:
eric: Morning — planning a cutover tomorrow 08:00 UTC for API -> runtime v3. Need owners for runtime, console, router, and an ops shim. Quick preflight checklist below, pls ack and claim ownership. https://go/release/1234

maya: I can own runtime side. I'll pin runtime-3.0 canary and run the batching/kv smoke.

raj: Router header-swap is ready, but we need a traffic-shim during header flip. I can operate the shim with ops-oncall during the first 15m.

sophia: Console changes are minimal; I will push release notes and patch the console routes. Will watch for schema mismatch alerts.

ops-oncall: I can stand up the traffic-shim and run the telemetry checks. Which metrics should we baseline?

eric: Baseline p50/p95 latency and 5xx rate for each service for last 1h. If p95 increases > 200ms or 5xx delta > 1.5% absolute for 10m, we rollback. Also watch KV eviction and mem pressure.

maya: pin command I'm going to use (will run after dry-run):
```bash
deploy-bot pin service=runtime variant=runtime-3.0 scope=canary until=2024-05-02 note="cutover dryrun claim: maya"
```

deploy-bot: Received pin request: service=runtime variant=runtime-3.0 scope=canary. Dry-run suggested: OK. Reply with `confirm` to execute.

maya: confirm

deploy-bot: Pin applied: runtime -> runtime-3.0 (canary). TTL 2024-05-02.

raj: For router I'll apply a header shim that duplicates incoming header X-RI-Route to X-Next-Route and route by X-Next-Route for 10% traffic. Implementation snippet: 
```yaml
- match: any
  set_header: X-Next-Route: "{{X-RI-Route}}"
  route_split: 
    - weight: 90
      handler: existing
    - weight: 10
      handler: runtime-v3
```

sophia: I've updated the release notes with the header shim and a rollback section. Link: https://go/release/1234/notes. Added note to alert on schema mismatch and console render-errors.

ops-oncall: Starting telemetry smoke now: subscribing p50/p95, 5xx, kv_evictions, mem_rss. I'll post first baseline in 5m.

(5 minutes later)
ops-oncall: Baseline captured: runtime p95=120ms p50=35ms 5xx=0.4% kv_evictions=0.02%

eric: Good. Plan: at 08:00 UTC we do a staged shift: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100 with 5m holds. Owners: runtime=maya, router=raj, console=sophia, ops=ops-oncall. Rollback on: 
- 5xx delta > 1.5% absolute over baseline for 10m
- p95 increase > 200ms for 10m
- any KV eviction spike > 0.5%

maya: I'll watch model kv cache and batching; will signal `rollback runtime` to deploy-bot if we hit thresholds.

raj: I'll watch router metrics and remove shim if we see routing flaps. Command to remove shim: `deploy-bot unshim router --name cutover-171721`

deploy-bot: NOTE: automated rollback requires owner confirmation. To execute automated rollback run: `deploy-bot rollback service=<service> reason="<short-reason>"`

sophia: Small nit — console has a legacy client that ignores X-Next-Route; I'll patch a compatibility header on the canary path to avoid 4xx. Deploying patch to console canary now.

ops-oncall: telemetry: after 10m hold at 5% shift — runtime p95=140ms p50=40ms 5xx=0.6% kv_evictions unchanged. Still within thresholds.

eric: Excellent. Everyone keep headphones on. If any owner posts `rollback <service>` I will open the cross-team rollback and signal a full traffic reversion.

maya: ack. Claiming canary owner. Will post final go/no-go 07:50 UTC.

raj: ack. I'll script a quick rollback for router + remove shim.

sophia: ack. I'll be on-call for console observations.

eric: Locking owners list: runtime=maya, router=raj, console=sophia, ops=ops-oncall. Documenting final checklist in the release notes and pinning this thread. :lock: :thumbsup:

maya: thanks — moving to preflight.

ops-oncall: 👍 starting watch window.

(ends)
